::: {.dynamic .horizontal .controls-top header="🕹️ Simulation Interactive : Interpolation dans l'Espace Latent (AE vs VAE)"} 

::: {.controls header="Modèle"}
Sélectionnez l'architecture et naviguez directement dans l'espace mathématique en faisant glisser le curseur.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
```

::: {.render .transparent .flex-grow-2 header="Espace Latent 2D (AE vs VAE)"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// 1. Initialisation de l'espace 2D (Inspiré du Codebook VQ-VAE)
viewof latentPos = {
  const width = 10;
  const height = 10;
  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("width", "100%")
    .attr("height", "100%")
    .attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`)
    .style("background", theme.base03)
    .style("border-radius", "12px")
    .style("box-shadow", "inset 0 0 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)");

  // Définition des dégradés VAE
  const defs = svg.append("defs");
  const gradA = defs.append("radialGradient").attr("id", "gradA2D");
  gradA.append("stop").attr("offset", "0%").attr("stop-color", theme.blue).attr("stop-opacity", 0.4);
  gradA.append("stop").attr("offset", "100%").attr("stop-color", theme.blue).attr("stop-opacity", 0);
  const gradB = defs.append("radialGradient").attr("id", "gradB2D");
  gradB.append("stop").attr("offset", "0%").attr("stop-color", theme.red).attr("stop-opacity", 0.4);
  gradB.append("stop").attr("offset", "100%").attr("stop-color", theme.red).attr("stop-opacity", 0);

  const pA = {x: 2, y: 2}, pB = {x: 8, y: 8};

  // Calques
  const layerDist = svg.append("g").attr("class", "layer-dist");
  const layerPoints = svg.append("g").attr("class", "layer-points");
  const handle = svg.append("g").attr("class", "handle").style("cursor", "grab");

  // Points d'ancrage fixes
  layerPoints.append("circle").attr("cx", pA.x).attr("cy", pA.y).attr("r", 0.2).attr("fill", theme.blue);
  layerPoints.append("circle").attr("cx", pB.x).attr("cy", pB.y).attr("r", 0.2).attr("fill", theme.red);
  layerPoints.append("text").attr("x", pA.x).attr("y", pA.y - 0.5).attr("fill", theme.base3).attr("text-anchor", "middle").style("font-size", "0.6px").style("font-weight", "bold").text("Chat");
  layerPoints.append("text").attr("x", pB.x).attr("y", pB.y + 1).attr("fill", theme.base3).attr("text-anchor", "middle").style("font-size", "0.6px").style("font-weight", "bold").text("Chien");

  // Handle (Curseur 2D)
  handle.append("circle").attr("r", 0.4).attr("fill", "none").attr("stroke", theme.yellow).attr("stroke-width", 0.08);
  handle.append("circle").attr("r", 0.15).attr("fill", theme.yellow);

  // Dragging logic
  svg.call(d3.drag()
    .on("start", () => handle.style("cursor", "grabbing"))
    .on("drag", (event) => {
      const [mx, my] = d3.pointer(event, svg.node());
      const x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width, mx));
      const y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height, my));
      svg.node().value = {x, y};
      svg.node().dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input"));
    })
    .on("end", () => handle.style("cursor", "grab"))
  );

  svg.node().value = {x: 2, y: 2};
  return svg.node();
}

// 2. Mise à jour réactive précise
_updateLatent2D = {
  const pos = latentPos;
  const mode = modeVAE;
  const svg = d3.select(viewof latentPos);
  const pA = {x: 2, y: 2}, pB = {x: 8, y: 8};

  // Update Handle Position
  svg.select(".handle").attr("transform", `translate(${pos.x}, ${pos.y})`);

  // Update Visual State (AE vs VAE)
  const layerDist = svg.select(".layer-dist");
  layerDist.selectAll("*").remove();
  
  if (mode === "vae") {
    layerDist.append("circle").attr("cx", pA.x).attr("cy", pA.y).attr("r", 5).style("fill", "url(#gradA2D)");
    layerDist.append("circle").attr("cx", pB.x).attr("cy", pB.y).attr("r", 5).style("fill", "url(#gradB2D)");
  } else {
    // AE: Zones restreintes
    layerDist.append("circle").attr("cx", pA.x).attr("cy", pA.y).attr("r", 1.2).attr("fill", "rgba(38, 139, 210, 0.2)");
    layerDist.append("circle").attr("cx", pB.x).attr("cy", pB.y).attr("r", 1.2).attr("fill", "rgba(220, 50, 47, 0.2)");
  }
}

// 3. Calcul de l'alpha consolidé pour le rendu final
alphaLatent = {
  const pos = latentPos;
  const pA = {x: 2, y: 2}, pB = {x: 8, y: 8};
  const dA = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(pos.x - pA.x, 2) + Math.pow(pos.y - pA.y, 2));
  const dB = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(pos.x - pB.x, 2) + Math.pow(pos.y - pB.y, 2));
  
  // Le ratio de distance dA / (dA + dB) est plus intuitif en 2D pour l'alpha
  return dA / (dA + dB);
}
```

::: {.render header="Sortie"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Générateur du résultat en fonction de la position et de l'architecture
{
  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText = "display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100%; padding: 10px;";
  
  let emoji = "";
  let confidence = 0;
  let textOut = "";
  let isGlitch = false;

  if (modeVAE === "vae") {
    // Logique VAE : Interpolation douce (Confidence & Labels)
    confidence = 0.85 + (Math.abs(alphaLatent - 0.5) * 0.3);
    if (alphaLatent < 0.2) textOut = "Concept : Chat";
    else if (alphaLatent > 0.8) textOut = "Concept : Chien";
    else textOut = "Espace Latent : Transition Cohérente";
  } else {
    // Logique AE classique : Chute brutale de cohérence au milieu
    if (alphaLatent < 0.15) {
      emoji = "🐱"; textOut = "Chat"; confidence = 0.98;
    } else if (alphaLatent > 0.85) {
      emoji = "🐶"; textOut = "Chien"; confidence = 0.98;
    } else {
      isGlitch = true;
      confidence = Math.max(0, 1 - (Math.abs(alphaLatent - 0.5) * 5)); // Chute drastique vers 0
      textOut = "ERREUR: Point mort dans l'espace";
    }
  }

  // Effet "Glitch" (Bruit latent) pour l'AE au milieu
  if (isGlitch) {
    const glitches = ["🤡", "🤖", "👽", "👻", "👹", "👺", "🌚", "🌝", "👾", "💩", "🦄", "🧟", "🧠", "🐷", "🐸", "🐵", "🐔", "🐨", "🐯", "🐮", "🐧", "🤪", "😵", "🧐"];
    emoji = glitches[Math.floor(Math.random() * glitches.length)];
  }

  // Rendu UI
  const displayEmoji = document.createElement("div");
  displayEmoji.style.cssText = `font-size: 4em; height: 1.2em; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; position: relative; filter: ${isGlitch ? 'hue-rotate(90deg) blur(2px)' : 'none'}`;

  if (modeVAE === "vae") {
    // Cross-fade triple pour une transition fluide (Chat -> Fox -> Chien)
    const createLayer = (txt, op) => {
      const span = document.createElement("span");
      span.innerText = txt;
      span.style.cssText = `position: absolute; opacity: ${op}; transition: opacity 0.1s;`;
      return span;
    };
    
    let opCat = 0, opFox = 0, opDog = 0;
    if (alphaLatent <= 0.5) {
      opCat = 1 - (alphaLatent * 2);
      opFox = alphaLatent * 2;
    } else {
      opFox = 1 - ((alphaLatent - 0.5) * 2);
      opDog = (alphaLatent - 0.5) * 2;
    }
    
    displayEmoji.appendChild(createLayer("🐱", opCat));
    displayEmoji.appendChild(createLayer("🦊", opFox));
    displayEmoji.appendChild(createLayer("🐶", opDog));
  } else {
    displayEmoji.innerText = emoji;
  }

  const desc = document.createElement("div");
  desc.style.cssText = `font-family: monospace; margin-top: 10px; color: ${isGlitch ? theme.red : theme.cyan}; font-weight: bold;`;
  desc.innerText = textOut;

  // Jauge de cohérence mathématique
  const meterCont = document.createElement("div");
  meterCont.style.cssText = `width: 100%; background: ${theme.base2}; height: 10px; border-radius: 5px; margin-top: 15px; overflow: hidden;`;
  const fill = document.createElement("div");
  fill.style.cssText = `width: ${confidence * 100}%; height: 100%; background: ${confidence > 0.5 ? theme.green : theme.red}; transition: width 0.3s;`;
  meterCont.appendChild(fill);
  
  const meterLabel = document.createElement("div");
  meterLabel.style.cssText = `font-size: 0.8em; color: ${theme.base03}; margin-top: 5px;`;
  meterLabel.innerText = `Cohérence sémantique : ${(confidence * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;

  container.appendChild(displayEmoji);
  container.appendChild(desc);
  container.appendChild(meterCont);
  container.appendChild(meterLabel);

  return container;
}
```
